fields.description: Still pending at the start of the current month (carried in from earlier months).
fields.label: Opening Qty

fields.description: Issued into this warehouse during the CURRENT month. Month-by-month history is in the Employee Warehouse Tracking report.
fields.label: Issue Qty (This Month)

fields.description: Returned out of this warehouse during the CURRENT month (every outward movement that is not a Process Loss).
fields.label: Receive Qty (This Month)

fields.description: Written off during the CURRENT month via a Process Loss Stock Entry.
fields.label: Loss Qty (This Month)

fields.description: CUMULATIVE balance still held, all months: Opening + Issue - Receive - Loss. This is the figure the Receive dialog settles against.
fields.label: Pending Qty (Total)
